description_zh: 必點：咖啡、檸檬派。隱身Ekamai 22商場的溫暖小角落，手沖咖啡配自製甜點，是上班族的秘密據點。
address: 76, 5 Soi Ekkamai 22, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated specialty café in Bangkok. Known for The lighting.
description_zh: 必點：燈光。這家咖啡館的設計靠光線說話，陽光透過巧妙的角度灑進來，讓早午餐時光變得特別溫柔。窩在這裡發呆，比吃什麼都舒服。
address: Sammitr, 51 Soi Sukhumvit 16, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Hip, stylish cafe with a vintage aesthetic offering espresso drinks, Western dishes & a gift shop.
description_zh: 必點：義大利麵、牛排。時尚復古的咖啡廳，濃厚文青氛圍，濃郁義式濃縮咖啡搭配西餐，還有質感雜貨可逛。
address: 60 Soi Ekkamai 12, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded specialty café in Bangkok. Known for Experience from here.
description_zh: 必點：手沖咖啡、牛油果吐司。坐在綠意盎然的角落，享受曼谷難得的寧靜時光。
address: 9 Thanon Chom Thong, Khwaeng Chom Thong, Khet Chom Thong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10150, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised specialty café in Bangkok. Known for Croissant and There.
description_zh: 必點：可頌、泰式奶茶。隱身在曼谷林蔭小巷的咖啡館，法式可頌酥脆香濃，搭配濃郁泰奶最絕。
address: 1351/1-5 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khwaeng Bang Lamphu Lang, Khet Khlong San, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised specialty café in Bangkok.
description_zh:
必點：手沖咖啡、可頌麵包。
小巷裡的隱藏咖啡館，老闆親自烘豆，每杯都用心萃取。適合晨間獨處或與朋友閒聊的地方。
address: 108 Thanon Khlong Lamchiak, Khwaeng Nawamin, Khet Bueng Kum, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10230, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated specialty café in Bangkok.
description_zh: 必點：手作甜點、特選咖啡。坐在老奶奶親手打造的花園裡，享受慢活時光，每個角落都能感受到用心與溫度。
address: Bang Khae, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded specialty café in Bangkok.
description_zh: 必點：手工漢堡、冷萃咖啡。N10café藏在曼谷街角，老闆堅持用在地食材，咖啡豆自己烘焙。來這裡就是為了享受慢節奏的午後。
address: 342 ซอยวัดระฆัง ถนนพรานนก แขวงศิริราช เขตบางกอกน้อย Khwaeng Siriraj, Khet Bangkok Noi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10700, Thailand

description_en: Coffee, cake & entrees like curry in an upscale setting with a vintage European conservatory feel.
description_zh: 必點：咖啡、糕點。歐式古董溫室風格的優雅咖啡館，咖哩等主菜搭配精緻甜點，散發懷舊貴氣。
address: 33, 25 Pradit Manutham Rd, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Khet Lat Phrao, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10230, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised specialty café in Bangkok. Known for Croissant and Health drinks.
description_zh: 必點：牛角包、健康飲品。Dolcetto是曼谷隱藏的義大利咖啡館，牛角包酥脆可口，新鮮果汁和健康飲品更是上班族的最愛。
address: 16, 18 Soi Somkid, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised specialty café in Bangkok. Known for Croissant.
description_zh: 必點：牛角麵包。曼谷少見的手工烘焙咖啡館，每日現做的牛角麵包層次酥脆，咖啡豆自家烘焙，是在地上班族最愛的晨間去處。
address: 34, 1 Soi Ton Son, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded specialty café in Bangkok. Known for Pasta.
description_zh: 必點：義大利麵。曼谷咖啡愛好者的祕密基地，咖啡講究，義麵也不馬虎，老闆親自把關每一杯和每一盤。
address: Velaa Sindhorn Village Langsuan, 87 ซ.หลังสวน แขวงลุมพินี เขตปทุมวัน กรุงเทพมหานคร 10330, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded specialty café in Bangkok. Known for Its minimalist design.
description_zh: 必點：咖啡、甜點。無印良品風格的極簡設計貫穿整間店，白色與木質調營造寧靜舒適的氛圍，是曼谷鬧區中難得的淨土。
address: 6th floor Central Chidlom, 1027 Thanon Phloen Chit, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded specialty café in Bangkok. Known for Croissant and Espresso.
description_zh: 必點：牛角包、濃縮咖啡。暹羅發現購物中心內的隱藏咖啡廳，烘焙功夫深厚，牛角包層次分明酥脆，濃縮咖啡香氣撲鼻。
address: 3rd Floor, Siam Discovery, Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated specialty café in Bangkok.
description_zh: 必點：手工咖啡、特色調酒。坐在曼谷街角，看著來往的摩托車和行人，這裡混合了咖啡館的悠閒和酒吧的熱鬧，是傍晚轉向夜晚的完美中途站。
address: ชั้น G โรงแรมหัวช้าง เฮอริเทจ กรุงเทพฯ 400 Phaya Thai Rd, ปทุมวัน Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded specialty café in Bangkok. Known for Broccoli bacon quiche and Other dishes and desserts.
description_zh: 必點：花椰菜培根鹹派、各式甜點。法式咖啡館氛圍溫暖，手工派皮酥脆，是曼谷上班族最愛的早午餐秘境。
address: 65 2 Thanon Witthayu, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, popular shopping destination in Bangkok.
description_zh: 必點：炸豬皮、芒果糯米飯。班塔當夜市是曼谷人最愛的庶民美食天堂，攤位密集、人氣旺盛，從街頭小食到服飾雜貨應有盡有。晚間7點後才開門，是體驗在地夜生活的必去之地。
address: 344, 328 ซ. จุฬาลงกรณ์ 1 Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Large shopping complex features multiple levels of retailers, services & restaurants in modern digs.
description_zh: 必點：現場音樂表演。暹羅中心是曼谷最摩登的購物地標，樓層眾多、品牌齊全，邊逛邊享受駐唱樂手的氛圍，購物體驗特別有靈魂。
address: 979 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Expansive mall with high-end & mainstream boutiques, dining, an aquarium, bowling & a multiplex.
description_zh: 必點：水族館、美食廣場。暹羅百麗宮是曼谷最大的購物地標，集高端精品、餐飲娛樂於一身，逛到腳軟才甘願。週末人潮洶湧，但各樓層設計寬敞舒服，連不愛購物的人也能消磨半天。
address: 991 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, popular shopping destination in Bangkok. Known for Its trendy boutiques.
description_zh: 必點：潮牌精品店。暹羅廣場是曼谷最潮的購物地標，雲集國際設計師品牌和本地新銳設計師，年輕人必逛。
address: 1 Siam Square Soi 7, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, popular shopping destination in Bangkok. Known for Shoes and Bed sheets.
description_zh: 必點：鞋款、床品。曼谷最大購物殿堂，匯集國際名牌與泰國設計，鞋類選擇豐富，床品質量上乘。逛完還能在商場內用餐休息。
address: 451 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Vast, stylish mall with hundreds of high-end shops & restaurants, plus an indoor floating market.
description_zh: 必點：泰式甜品、咖啡。這座超大型商城匯集頂級品牌與餐廳，室內水上市集重現曼谷風情，是逛街美食的一站式天堂。
address: 299 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Ton Sai, Khet Khlong San, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

description_en: Renowned indoor marketplace for select produce, meat & seafood, plus snacks & kitchen supplies.
description_zh: 必點：芒果糯米飯、泰奶。Or Tor Kor Market是曼谷最講究的菜市場，蔬果肉海鮮都挑過，在地人才來這裡。邊逛邊吃小食，還能買齊廚房用具。
address: 101 Thanon Yan Phahon Yothin, Khwaeng Chatuchak, Khet Chatuchak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10900, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated bar in Bangkok. Known for Cocktails and Rooftop View.
description_zh: 必點：特色雞尾酒、屋頂夜景。坐在曼谷最高的酒吧，看夜幕降臨時整座城市閃爍發光，調酒師手藝一流，每杯都值得細細品嚐。
address: 111 Thanon Ratchadamri, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated bar in Bangkok. Known for Rooftop View and Kind.
description_zh: 必點：天台景觀、特調雞尾酒。曼谷最佳夜景酒吧，俯瞰城市萬家燈火，調酒師手藝一流，氛圍輕鬆不浮誇。
address: 38th Floor JC Kevin Sathorn Bangkok Hotel Yannawa Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded bar in Bangkok. Known for Cocktails and Rooftop View.
description_zh: 必點：雞尾酒、屋頂景觀。曼谷夜景最靚的酒吧，調酒師手藝一流，坐擁城市夜色，值得一去。
address: 222 Ratchaprarop Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

name_en: The Japanese Highball Bar 1923 Krung Thep Thonglor
name_zh: The Japanese Highball Bar 1923 Krung Thep Thonglor
description_en: A mid-range, top-rated bar in Bangkok. Known for Cocktails.
description_zh: 必點：日式威士忌高球雞尾酒。昭和年代的酒吧氛圍，在隆路夜生活區享受師傅精心調製的經典高球，是威士忌愛好者的秘密據點。
address: 335 Soi Thong Lo 17, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Small jazz & blues bar & live music joint with outdoor tables, decorated with music memorabilia.
description_zh: 必點：現場音樂、熱鬧氛圍。小而精的爵士藍調酒吧，音樂迷的寶藏地點，戶外座位邊喝酒邊聽樂手現場演奏，牆上掛滿音樂海報，根本是樂迷的聖殿。
address: 13 Thanon Samsen, Khwaeng Wat Sam Phraya, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated bar in Bangkok. Known for Cocktails and Live Music.
description_zh: 必點：特調雞尾酒、現場音樂。曼谷樂迷的秘密基地，每晚駐唱樂隊帶來道地藍調和搖滾，調酒師的創意特調更是一喝就停不下來。
address: 1103 ถ. เจริญกรุง Khwaeng Si Phraya, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

name_en: The Iron Fairies Music Bar Bangkok
name_zh: The Iron Fairies Music Bar Bangkok
description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded bar in Bangkok. Known for Cocktails and Live Music.
description_zh: 必點：特調雞尾酒、現場音樂。鐵仙子酒吧藏身曼谷老城區，昏黃燈光配上駐唱樂手的深情演奏，調酒師的每杯作品都像在說故事。來這裡的人都會多待一小時。
address: 1-2 Soi Sukhumvit 39, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated bar in Bangkok. Known for Cocktails.
description_zh: 必點：特色雞尾酒。曼谷最具創意的調酒吧，調酒師手藝高超，每杯都是藝術品。夜幕降臨後人氣爆滿，是當地人最愛的隱藏版酒吧。
address: 63 Soi Convent 2, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated bar in Bangkok. Known for Cocktails and Other drinks on the menu.
description_zh: 必點：特色雞尾酒、特調飲品。酒吧氛圍輕鬆有趣，調酒師手藝高超，是夜晚小酌的絕佳去處。
address: Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised bar in Bangkok. Known for Love the place and Ice and their service.
description_zh: 必點：冰飲、招牌服務。曼谷Silom區最懂調酒的酒吧，冰塊講究到不行，侍酒師記得每個常客的喜好。夜晚來這裡，根本是在喝一場用心。
address: G-FLOOR, PARK SILOM BUILDING, 1 Convent Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated bar in Bangkok.
description_zh: 必點：紅酒、調酒。曼谷最地道的葡萄酒吧，老闆是葡萄酒狂人，深夜來這裡小酌，聽著爵士樂，感受真正的歐洲酒館氛圍。
address: 2nd Floor, 281/16 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised bar in Bangkok. Known for Steak and Discovery.
description_zh: 必點：牛排、特色酒款。隱身巷弄的私密酒吧，牛排火候掌握得宜，搭配精選葡萄酒更顯風味。老闆挑酒的眼光獨到，常能發現意想不到的好貨。
address: 142 Soi Sueksa Wittaya, ซ. สาทร 12 แขวงสีลม เขตบางรัก กรุงเทพมหานคร 10500, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded bar in Bangkok. Known for Live Music and Choice.
description_zh: 必點：現場音樂、精選酒單。這間酒吧匯聚本地樂手，每晚現場演奏從爵士到搖滾，調酒師精心配搭進口與本地佳釀，是曼谷夜貓族的私房去處。
address: 389 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated bar in Bangkok. Known for Cocktails and For a nice cocktail.
description_zh: 必點：特色雞尾酒。曼谷最地道的酒吧，調酒師手藝高超，每杯都是藝術品。夜幕降臨後人氣爆棚，是在地人的私密據點。
address: 185 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated bar in Bangkok. Known for Rooftop View and Live Music.
description_zh: 必點：屋頂景觀、現場音樂。夜幕降臨時登上露台，俯瞰曼谷璀璨夜景，現場樂隊演奏襯托微醺氛圍，是Silom區最值得一去的屋頂酒吧。
address: 9th Floor, 2 Si Lom Rd, Khwaeng Suriya Wong, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Upmarket hotel with riverfront dining, a bar & a rooftop cigar lounge, plus a spa & an outdoor pool.
description_zh: 必點：泰式傳統服裝。薩利爾河濱酒店融合現代奢華與湄南河畔風景，頂層雪茄酒廊與河濱餐飲是在地人偷閒的秘密角落。
address: 2052/7-9 Soi Charoen Krung 72/1, Khwaeng Wat Phraya Krai, Khet Bang Kho Laem, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Polished rooms in a premium hotel offering a refined restaurant & a rooftop bar with river views.
description_zh: 必點：河景雞尾酒。高級飯店的寬敞房間設計簡潔，頂樓酒吧面向昭披耶河，夜景迷人。餐廳料理水準穩定，適合想在曼谷河畔享受寧靜夜晚的旅客。
address: 47-49 Soi Tha Tian, Khwaeng Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Elegant riverside hotel featuring refined villas, an outdoor pool & dining, plus tropical gardens.
description_zh: 必點：河畔別墅、熱帶花園。坐落湄南河邊的隱密綠洲，精緻別墅搭配無邊泳池，曼谷少見的悠閒度假感。
address: 396/1 พระบรรม วัง, Thanon Maha Rat, Khwaeng Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Polished quarters in an upscale riverside hotel with terrace dining, an outdoor pool & a hot tub.
description_zh: 必點：河濱位置。Riva Surya坐擁湄南河景，露台用餐邊喝酒邊看夕陽西下，池畔放鬆最舒服。
address: 23 Thanon Phra Athit, Khwaeng Chana Songkhram, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Sleek hotel with river views, offering bars & a rooftop pool, plus a spa & elegant dining.
description_zh: 必點：雞尾酒。河景時尚飯店，頂樓泳池絕美，適合傍晚來杯調酒看湄南河夕陽。
address: 257 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khwaeng Samre, Khet Thon Buri, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

description_en: Built in 1782, this ornate royal palace complex now houses a museum & is open to visitors.
description_zh: 必點：華麗建築、皇室工藝品。1782年建成的大皇宮金碧輝煌，現已開放參觀。繁複細緻的裝飾工藝令人嘆為觀止，是曼谷最耀眼的皇家瑰寶。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, top-rated restaurant in Bangkok. Known for The manager.
description_zh: 必點：主廚特餐。餐廳由經驗豐富的主廚主持，用心烹調每一道泰式料理，親切服務讓人有回家的感覺。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, highly praised restaurant in Bangkok. Known for Crab meat fried rice.
description_zh: 必點：蟹肉炒飯。暹羅廣場美食街匯集曼谷最道地的街頭小食，蟹肉炒飯香氣逼人，粒粒分明，是在地人回訪率最高的必吃。
address: Bangkok, Thailand

description_en: A mid-range, well-regarded restaurant in Bangkok.
description_zh: 必點：燒烤海鮮、冬陰功湯。沙吞區集結曼谷最道地的夜間美食攤檔，沿街都是在地人邊喝啤酒邊享受的平民食堂，夜幕降臨才是這裡真正的用餐時間。
address: Bangkok, Thailand
